chunks: Sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
And eat of what Allah has provided for you as lawful and good.
And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of combining verses on divine sufficiency and lawful sustenance in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq curates this narration to underscore the theological link between *tawakkul* (trust in God) and ethical consumption, reflecting the Imami emphasis on aligning daily sustenance with divine decree. This compilation serves as a creedal reminder that lawful (*halal*) sustenance is not merely a legal requirement but a spiritual conduit for accountability, reinforcing the eschatological awareness central to Shia doctrinal formation.
